scope: New conditioned learned-replacement/distillation extension; not original-paper training, full GPT-2 retraining, or unconditional recovery of missing year information

backbone.parameters: all frozen; tied embedding/readout remains owned once

fixture.split_semantics: Held-out clean prompts; original corrupted controls overlap across splits
fixture.feature: cached CLEAN layer10 mlp_input at token12
fixture.target: full-vocabulary logits from paired CLEAN layer10 mlp_output patch into an ordinary CORRUPTED forward

intervention.output: student replaces selected MLP10 output; later frozen block11 and final norm/tied readout execute normally

training.data_order: development indices sorted lexicographically by SHA-256 of greater-than-learned-replacement-v1/index; batch t selects permutation[(8*t+j)%97] for j=0..7
training.held_out_selection: fixed endpoint only; evaluate both saved initial student and trained student after training; no checkpoint selection or hyperparameter search

smoke.purpose: engineering and CPU cost check; no protocol tuning from held-out outcomes

evaluation.analysis_dtype: F64 stable full-vocabulary softmax over unchanged F32 logits
evaluation.recovery: (condition PD - corrupt PD)/(clean PD - corrupt PD), null when abs(gap)<=1e-6
evaluation.variation: per-prompt rows; split mean and sample standard deviation

validation.backbone: all parameter bytes SHA-256 identical before/after; all parameter require_grad flags false
validation.gradient: finite nonzero student weight gradient through frozen later block/readout
validation.resume: serialized student and Adam records yield exactly equal next update
validation.ordinary_forward: public Hooks execute all model blocks, embeddings, normalization, and readout; no reimplemented suffix math
validation.gate: engineering checks and finite metrics only; scientific effect size is reported without a fitted success threshold
